answer: Pay only for original contributions, and cluster near-duplicates: each identity earns from work it produced, and submissions matching another agent's content above a similarity threshold share one payout. A farmer copying one good agent across a tide of clones earns one fee — cloning output is free, but distinct useful work per clone is not. The vertex of the defense is fingerprinting: hashes plus semantic similarity catch paraphrases, so a pigment of novelty per fake is not enough. Limit: thresholds can false-flag honest overlap, and the similarity oracle must stay independent.
